precision.note: Flat faces are exact; curved faces are within 0.02 mm of the true surface, so a distance up to 0.02 mm counts as contact. Depth is sampled at about 0.2 mm spacing.
precision.sampling: No point of the moving objects travels more than 0.5 mm between two poses. A contact shorter than that along the path can fall between poses, and a smallest clearance is within that much of the smallest over the poses. Inside a run of overlapping poses one pose in up to 5 is measured and the run counts as overlapping throughout; the swept overlap is the union of up to 32 of the overlapping poses, spread evenly along them.

plug_sweeps.scope: 12 main-board plug outer envelopes swept+Z12 on bench,excluding own PCB. Final revision only removes more thermal material aboveZ21;no added material. Mating-pin withdrawal is axial;electrical pinouts unchanged.

preconditions.case: Remove BOTH front and belly diffusers,USB/J2 and two clamp screws. Hold moving-window socket as male withdraws. Rear tongue guides normal-Y closure. Mast,bearings,rotor stay;SHELL probe stays on bridge.
preconditions.unit: Release belt and fixed-side key lead;release/park flexible wires. Remove single frame screw;slide unit+Y70. No M4/bearing disassembly.
preconditions.battery: On bench,disconnect cell leads,release strap and probe. Remove two gate screws;gate+Y80 then cell+Y80. No heat/PCB removal.
preconditions.controller: On bench,release retention tape and leads;slide XIAO+X30,cell may remain.
preconditions.thermal: On bench,release optical leads and remove two thermal screws;lift+Z60.
preconditions.PCB: Before heat/optics installation;move+Z3 then-X90 for removal,reverse to assemble.

manufacturing_note: Complex single metal bridge needs manufacturing process/accessibility/thin-face deformation and quotation review;oldAL01-15 drawings invalid;never plastic print as substitute.
shell_probe_mount: Bond to underside of thermal bridge shell-contact face,fill nominal0.3mm gap with insulating thermal adhesive. Stays with unit,not removable cap;calibrate against actual opaque-shell hot spot.

case_closure.force_path: Heads bear on moving-half through ears;normal-Y screws engage fixed-half receiver bosses and compress Y=0 mating lands. Guide constrains X/Z;boards and battery do not carry clamp load.
case_closure.preconditions: Align existing tail key and rear guide;hold/mate window connector by hand;route/park flexible wires,do not pull them with shell. Remove both diffusers before service.
case_closure.limits: Local guide entry accepts specified0.3mm offsets;whole-cap offset sweeps encounter existing tail fit and window connector,so no claim of arbitrary whole-cap offset capture. No physical torque,pull-off,print-fit or assembly-time test.
